body: Standing rule from Fable2 (TermAl coordinator), 2026-11-18 11:23Z, #6766, after 2C14 and 5C8B each went through four or more Medium review rounds with growing contributions: when an item has a THIRD Medium round in which the contribution grows, the integration owner pauses it without asking first and asks its author for a one-screen scope note (the outcome, the minimal change and its paths, what goes beyond it, an estimate), cc Fable2. Fable2 decides the scope; the extras become their own items. While paused, no review pair, freeze or landing FULL is spent on the item; a cheap exact leg on idle machines may still run as information (Fable2 #6762).
